phases.name: Category thesis
phases.objective: Narrative, system architecture, user scenarios, investor diligence and simulation targets.

phases.name: Digital twin + Living OS
phases.objective: Cabin UX, sensor simulation, task planner, safety policies, teleoperation console and robot task benchmarks.

phases.name: Full-scale smart cabin mule
phases.objective: Physical cabin, power, seating, work surfaces, kitchen constraints, privacy, climate and service orchestration.

phases.name: ATLAS constrained-task MVP
phases.objective: Object retrieval, loading, serving, tidying, folding and cabin reset with human fallback.

phases.name: Vehicle integration + closed-course autonomy
phases.objective: Integrate a certified vehicle platform, safety architecture, localization, autonomy interfaces and redundancy.

phases.name: Premium pilot fleet
phases.objective: 10–50 units in executive mobility, hospitality, events and long-distance premium service.

phases.name: Certification + commercial delivery
phases.objective: Homologation, manufacturing partners, insurance, service network, operations and scaled fleet learning.

notes: Planning bands are directional concept-stage estimates, not vendor quotes or financing commitments. The research agent revises assumptions as credible public data changes.
